description:
Extend the carry-less multiplication SIMD kernels (055bda14) with full-width AVX-512 paths:

## AVX-512 VPCLMULQDQ (512-bit, 4× throughput)

The current VPCLMULQDQ implementation uses 256-bit lanes (`_mm256_clmulepi64_epi128`), processing 2 multiplies per instruction. Full AVX-512 (`_mm512_clmulepi64_epi128`) would process 4 multiplies per instruction for 4× throughput over scalar PCLMULQDQ.

Requires: AVX-512F + VPCLMULQDQ CPU features (not available on all hardware).

## GF2P8AFFINEQB (GFNI) specialization

`GF2P8AFFINEQB` performs a GF(2) affine transformation over 8-bit elements. For GF(2^8) batch operations, this can be used to implement field multiplication as an affine transformation, potentially faster than PCLMULQDQ+Barrett for GF(2^8)-specific workloads.

Requires: AVX-512F + GFNI CPU features.

## Kernel API additions

```rust
/// Batch carry-less multiplication using 512-bit VPCLMULQDQ.
/// Processes 4 independent multiplications per instruction.
#[target_feature(enable = "avx512f", enable = "vpclmulqdq")]
pub unsafe fn clmul_batch_512(a: &[u64], b: &[u64], out: &mut [u128]);

/// GF(2^8) batch multiplication using GFNI affine transformation.
#[target_feature(enable = "avx512f", enable = "gfni")]
pub unsafe fn gf2p8_mul_batch(a: &[u8], b: &[u8], out: &mut [u8], affine_matrix: &[u8; 8]);
```

## Dependencies

- 055bda14 (carry-less multiplication SIMD kernels) — provides the 256-bit foundation
- 4b5d8948 (AVX-512 SIMD backend) — provides the AVX-512 infrastructure

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: 512-bit VPCLMULQDQ batch produces identical results to 256-bit and sequential paths
- [aspirational] REQ-02: ≥10× throughput over scalar for batch dot products on AVX-512 hardware
- [hard] REQ-03: GFNI GF(2^8) batch multiplication matches PCLMULQDQ+Barrett for correctness
- [hard] REQ-04: Runtime detection gracefully falls back when AVX-512F/VPCLMULQDQ/GFNI unavailable
title: Implement AVX-512 VPCLMULQDQ (512-bit) and GF2P8AFFINEQB GFNI kernels for GF(2^m)
